legal.title: Scope of these website terms
legal.body: These terms govern the public use of FYHOM's website. They do not replace individual brokerage agreements, reservation arrangements, deposit agreements, property sale contracts or notarial deeds. Applicable statutory information requirements and valid individual agreements take precedence.

legal.title: Real-estate regulations in Valencia
legal.body: Real-estate intermediation in the Valencian Community is subject to applicable sector-specific rules, including where applicable Decree 98/2022 and the Valencian property intermediary register (RAICV). The current registration number and required professional insurance documents must be checked against official evidence; this notice does not claim that a specific registration has been independently verified.

legal.title: Property listings are indicative
legal.body: Descriptions, floor areas, plans, prices, construction stages, energy information, projections and availability are for initial information. Some details originate with owners, developers or other parties and may change. They must be verified against current documentation before any transaction. Mandatory consumer protections remain unaffected.

legal.title: Available and sold properties
legal.body: Properties labelled Sold are displayed as references and cannot be enquired about through their original listing. A listing marked available does not guarantee ongoing availability. For properties with an unpublished price, the price is available on request. Legally required information about purchase costs must be provided at the appropriate stage.

legal.title: Enquiries, viewings and assistance
legal.body: Submitting an enquiry, buyer search, seller form or valuation request does not itself create a purchase, reservation or fee-bearing brokerage contract. Viewings, airport pick-ups, notary accompaniment, administrative assistance and similar concierge services are subject to separate arrangements and any agreed conditions.

legal.title: Agency fees and professional services
legal.body: Any brokerage fees, travel expenses and other charges must be agreed transparently and in accordance with applicable law. Taxes, legal, accounting, notarial and other professional services may be charged separately. FYHOM does not substitute regulated legal, tax or notarial advice from authorised professionals.

legal.title: Reservations and payments
legal.body: Any reservation, deposit, earnest-money agreement or sale contract requires individual checking and written documentation. Do not send money solely because of a website listing or an unverified message. Contractual documents and verified instructions from the parties and notary are decisive.

legal.title: New builds, land and commercial premises
legal.body: Marketing renders and example plans may differ from final construction. Ownership, cadastral data, zoning, utility connections, building permissions and licences for plots and commercial premises must be checked. An advertisement is not proof of planning or operating approval.

legal.title: Copyright, photographs and trademarks
legal.body: Texts, trademarks, images, architectural plans, software and designs may be protected by rights held by FYHOM or third parties. Browsing this site does not grant a licence to copy or commercially reuse materials. Photographs and developer imagery remain subject to their respective rights.

legal.title: Acceptable use
legal.body: Visitors may use the site lawfully for information and communication. Malware, attempts to disrupt or bypass security, unlawful content and unauthorised bulk extraction of information are prohibited.

legal.title: Third-party websites
legal.body: Links to WhatsApp or other services lead to independent operators with their own legal terms and privacy policies. Their continued availability and all their practices are outside FYHOM's direct control.

legal.title: Liability and consumer rights
legal.body: FYHOM's liability is governed by applicable law. Descriptions of indicative information do not remove mandatory statutory rights, liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or applicable consumer protection.

legal.title: Applicable law and complaints
legal.body: Spanish law generally applies, without prejudice to mandatory consumer rules and legally required courts of jurisdiction. Questions and complaints may be sent to info@fyhom.es.

legal.title: Updates and legal review
legal.body: Version dated 22 October 2026. Changes to company information, services or the website may require an update. These texts should be reviewed by appropriately qualified legal counsel in Spain before being treated as final binding terms.

privacy.title: Data controller
privacy.body: Fyhom Villas S.L., NIF B26808956, Camino Guadiana, 15C, 03779 Els Poblets (Alicante), Spain. Contact: info@fyhom.es. This notice applies to the new FYHOM website and its forms.

privacy.title: Legal framework
privacy.body: Personal data are handled in line with the GDPR, applicable Spanish data-protection legislation (including LOPDGDD) and other applicable requirements. No account is needed to browse public property listings.

privacy.title: Information you provide
privacy.body: Search, seller, valuation and contact forms may collect a name, email address, telephone number, property type, location, budget, requirements, property particulars and message text. Please do not include sensitive information in free-text fields.

privacy.title: Purposes and lawful bases
privacy.body: Data are used to reply to enquiries and take pre-contractual steps where appropriate (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)). Technical security, abuse prevention and customer correspondence may be based on legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)). If a separate consent is needed, it is requested under Art. 6(1)(a) and can be withdrawn.

privacy.title: Required fields and marketing
privacy.body: Mandatory fields are intended to make a response possible. A checkbox acknowledging the privacy notice is not blanket permission to send marketing. Promotional mailings would require an appropriate independent basis.

privacy.title: Telephone, email and WhatsApp
privacy.body: When you contact FYHOM directly, relevant messages and contact details are processed to reply. Clicking WhatsApp opens a third-party service governed by its own policies. Please agree on a suitable channel for particularly confidential material.

privacy.title: Hosting and technical logs
privacy.body: Cloudflare Pages serves this site. To deliver and protect the site, Cloudflare may process IP addresses, request times, requested resources, browser and device data, and security events. Precise log retention and applicable data-processing terms require verification with the provider.

privacy.title: Catalogue administration
privacy.body: Listing information is maintained in GitHub. Authorised staff sign into the private admin panel through GitHub OAuth and Cloudflare functions; these services can handle authentication data. Ordinary visitors do not need GitHub accounts.

privacy.title: Business mailbox and email delivery
privacy.body: The info@fyhom.es mailbox is operated through IONOS and may also be accessed using a Gmail connection. Resend is prepared as an optional future delivery provider for website forms but must first be configured and tested. Until then visitors can choose to send an email manually.

privacy.title: Recipients and service providers
privacy.body: Cloudflare provides hosting services; IONOS and, depending on the mailbox connection, Google may be involved in business email handling. Resend would process the form data needed for transmission only after activation. Relevant property enquiry information may be shared with owners, developers or professional advisers when a proper legal basis applies.

privacy.title: External resources
privacy.body: Where Google Fonts or images from Unsplash are loaded remotely, the providers may receive technical connection data. The site should be audited to decide whether to host assets locally or apply other safeguards. WhatsApp is only opened following a visitor's own action.

privacy.title: Transfers outside the EEA
privacy.body: Some providers may operate outside the European Economic Area. Applicable adequacy decisions, safeguards or standard contractual clauses must be checked against actual contracts and data flows. This notice does not assert that unverified safeguards are already in place.

privacy.title: Retention and deletion
privacy.body: Enquiry details are retained only for their necessary purpose and any applicable record-keeping or legal obligations. Exact deletion periods for mailboxes, hosting logs and other providers must be documented before final legal approval.

privacy.title: Your GDPR rights
privacy.body: Subject to statutory conditions, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability or object to processing. Consent may be withdrawn with effect for the future. Contact info@fyhom.es.

privacy.title: Complaints
privacy.body: You may complain to a competent data protection authority, including the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD), www.aepd.es. You are also welcome to contact FYHOM directly with concerns.

privacy.title: Automated decisions
privacy.body: The current contact forms do not provide for solely automated decisions producing legal or similarly significant effects. New functionality would require an updated assessment and information.

privacy.title: Security and updates
privacy.body: Encrypted connections and access restrictions are used for website operation and administration, although no internet system is entirely risk-free. Version: 22 October 2026. This notice must be kept updated when systems or providers change.

cookies.title: About cookies and local storage
cookies.body: Cookies and similar browser storage technologies can retain information on a device. These notes apply to the new FYHOM website, not the previous WordPress site.

cookies.title: Language preference
cookies.body: When you choose a language, the browser stores a localStorage item named fyhom-lang with your selected code (de, es, en, fr, nl or ru). It restores your expressed preference on future visits and is not used for advertising or profiling. It remains until you change the language or clear the site's browser data.

cookies.title: Technically necessary functions
cookies.body: Hosting and security may involve strictly necessary browser or network operations. Public browsing requires no sign-in. GitHub authentication is used only for authorised administrators.

cookies.title: Analytics and advertising
cookies.body: The current site code does not install Google Analytics, Meta Pixel or comparable advertising-tracking scripts. If non-essential tracking is introduced, required information and valid consent controls must be implemented before activation.

cookies.title: External assets
cookies.body: Some images or fonts may load from third-party servers and transfer technical connection data even without cookies. These connections require review. Clicking a WhatsApp link deliberately opens that external service.

cookies.title: Consent and refusal
cookies.body: Under applicable Spanish guidance, non-essential cookies and tracking generally need prior valid consent. Accept and Reject should be equally easy to select. The new site currently provides no advertising/statistics cookie preferences because such tools are not installed.

cookies.title: Managing browser storage
cookies.body: You can change the selected language on the website or remove fyhom-lang using your browser's site-data settings. You can also clear cookies and website storage. Disabling necessary storage may affect site features.

cookies.title: Private administrator cookies
cookies.body: Authorised administrators may encounter GitHub or Cloudflare session/security cookies during login. These are not required merely to view public property listings.

cookies.title: Updates and contact
cookies.body: Updated 22 October 2026. This information will be revised if tracking, services or browser storage change. Questions: info@fyhom.es.
